args.title: Fix password reset email link base URL configuration
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link currently uses a hardcoded default localhost URL if the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This change proposes to update the base URL logic to correctly use the production or deployment URL from configuration, avoiding localhost in user-facing emails.
